verses.23:13: And if he fails to fulfill it, his offense will be upon himself; and if he pretends not to notice, he offends doubly;
verses.23:14: and if he has sworn in vain, he will not be justified, for his house will be filled with retribution.
verses.23:15: There is also another speech contrary to death; let it not be found in the inheritance of Jacob.
verses.23:16: For indeed, all these things will be taken away from the merciful, and they will not wallow in offenses.
verses.23:17: Do not let your mouth become accustomed to undisciplined speech, for there is a word of sin in it.
verses.23:18: Remember your father and your mother, for you stand in the midst of great men.
verses.23:19: Or else God might forget you in their sight, and, made foolish by your habit, you might suffer reproach, and you would have preferred not to be born, and you would curse the day of your birth.
verses.23:20: A man accustomed to words of reproach will not be instructed in all his days.
verses.23:21: Two kinds abound in sins, and a third brings wrath and destruction.
verses.23:22: A hot soul, like a burning fire, will not be extinguished until it swallows something.
verses.23:23: And a wicked man in the mouth of his flesh will not cease until he kindles a fire.
verses.23:24: To a fornicating man all bread is sweet; he will not grow tired of transgressing until the end.
verses.23:25: Every man who transgresses his own bed, despising his own soul and saying, "Who sees me?
verses.23:26: Darkness surrounds me, and walls cover me, and no one looks around at me; whom do I fear? The Most High will not be mindful of my offenses."
verses.23:27: And he does not understand that His eye sees all things, because the fear of such a man and the eyes of men fearing him drive the fear of God away from him;
verses.23:28: and he has not known that the eyes of the Lord are much more radiant than the sun, surveying all the ways of men, and the depth of the abyss, and the hearts of men, looking into the hidden places.
verses.23:29: For all things were known to the Lord God before they were created; so also after completion He looks upon all things.
verses.23:30: This man will be punished in the streets of the city, and like a horse's colt he will be put to flight, and where he did not expect it he will be caught.
verses.23:31: And he will be a disgrace to everyone, because he has not understood the fear of the Lord.
verses.23:32: So also every woman who leaves her husband and establishes an inheritance from another marriage:
verses.23:33: for first, she was unfaithful in the law of the Most High; second, she offended against her husband; third, she committed fornication in adultery, and established children for herself by another man.
verses.23:34: This woman will be brought into the assembly, and her children will be scrutinized:
verses.23:35: her children will not put down roots, and her branches will not bear fruit;
verses.23:36: she will leave her memory for a curse, and her disgrace will not be blotted out.
verses.23:37: And those who are left behind will recognize that nothing is better than the fear of God, and nothing is sweeter than to look to the commandments of the Lord.
verses.23:38: To follow the Lord is a great glory, for length of days will be received from Him.
verses.24:1: Wisdom will praise her own soul, and in God she will be honored, and in the midst of her people she will glory,
verses.24:2: and in the assemblies of the Most High she will open her mouth, and in the sight of His power she will glory:
verses.24:3: and in the midst of her people she will be exalted, and in the holy fullness she will be admired,
verses.24:4: and in the multitude of the chosen she will have praise, and among the blessed she will be blessed, saying:
verses.24:5: "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High, firstborn before every creature.
verses.24:6: I caused an unfailing light to rise in the heavens, and like a mist I covered all the earth.
verses.24:7: I dwelt in the highest places, and my throne was in a pillar of cloud.
verses.24:8: I went around the circuit of heaven alone, and I penetrated the depth of the abyss; I walked in the waves of the sea.
verses.24:9: And in every land I stood, and among every people,
verses.24:10: and in every nation I held the first place,
verses.24:11: and with power I trod upon the hearts of all the exalted and the humble. And among all these I sought rest, and in the inheritance of the Lord I will remain.
verses.24:12: Then the Creator of all commanded and spoke to me, and He who created me rested in my tabernacle.
verses.24:13: And He said to me, 'Dwell in Jacob, and receive an inheritance in Israel, and send down roots among My chosen ones.'
verses.24:14: From the beginning and before the ages I was created, and even to the coming age I will not cease; and in the holy dwelling I ministered before Him.
verses.24:15: And so in Zion I was established, and in the sanctified city likewise I rested, and in Jerusalem is my authority.
verses.24:16: And I took root in an honored people, and in the portion of my God is His inheritance, and in the fullness of the holy ones is my abiding place.
verses.24:17: I was exalted like a cedar in Lebanon, and like a cypress on Mount Zion;
verses.24:18: like a palm tree I was exalted in Kadesh, and like a planting of roses in Jericho.
verses.24:19: Like a lovely olive tree in the plains, and like a plane tree I was exalted beside the water in the streets.
verses.24:20: Like cinnamon and aromatic balsam I gave forth fragrance; like choice myrrh I gave sweetness of fragrance.
verses.24:21: And like storax and galbanum and onycha and stacte, and like uncut frankincense I perfumed my dwelling, and my fragrance is like unmixed balsam.
verses.24:22: I, like a terebinth, stretched out my branches, and my branches are of honor and grace.
verses.24:23: I, like a vine, brought forth sweetness of fragrance, and my blossoms are fruit of honor and uprightness.
verses.24:24: I am the mother of beautiful love, of fear, of knowledge, and of holy hope.
verses.24:25: In me is all grace of the way and of truth; in me is all hope of life and of strength.
verses.24:26: Come over to me, all who long for me, and be filled from my produce;
verses.24:27: for my spirit is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance is sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.24:28: My memory is in the generation of the ages.
verses.24:29: Those who eat me will still hunger, and those who drink me will still thirst.
verses.24:30: The one who listens to me will not be put to shame, and those who work in me will not sin;
verses.24:31: those who explain me will have eternal life."
verses.24:32: All these things are the book of life, and the covenant of the Most High, and the knowledge of truth.
verses.24:33: Moses commanded the law in the precepts of righteous deeds, and an inheritance for the house of Jacob, and promises for Israel.
verses.24:34: He appointed for David His servant to raise up from him a most mighty king, sitting upon the throne of honor forever.
verses.24:35: It is he who fills wisdom like the Pishon, and like the Tigris in the days of new fruits,
verses.24:36: who fills understanding to the full like the Euphrates, who multiplies it like the Jordan in the time of harvest,
verses.24:37: who sends forth discipline like light, and stands near like the Gihon in the day of vintage.
verses.24:38: He first completes knowing her, and the weaker one will not trace her out.
verses.24:39: For her thought has abounded from the sea, and her counsel from the great abyss.
verses.24:40: I have poured out wisdom as rivers.
verses.24:41: I am like a channel of immense water from a river; I am like a canal of a river, and like an aqueduct I went out from paradise.
verses.24:42: I said, "I will water my garden of plantings, and I will drench the fruit of my meadow."
verses.24:43: And look, my channel became abundant, and my river drew near to the sea,
verses.24:44: for I make instruction shine like the dawn for all, and I will declare it even far away.
verses.24:45: I will penetrate all the lower parts of the earth, look upon all who sleep, and give light to all who hope in the Lord.
verses.24:46: I will still pour out instruction like prophecy, and I will leave it to those who seek wisdom, and I will not cease throughout their generations, even into the holy age.
verses.24:47: See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all who seek out truth.
verses.25:1: In three things my spirit has found pleasure, which are approved before God and people:
verses.25:2: the harmony of brothers, and the love of neighbors, and a husband and wife who agree well with each other.
verses.25:3: My soul hates three kinds, and I am greatly burdened by their life:
verses.25:4: a proud poor man, a lying rich man, and an old man who is foolish and senseless.
verses.25:5: What you have not gathered in your youth, how will you find it in your old age?
verses.25:6: How beautiful is judgment for gray hair, and for elders to know counsel!
verses.25:7: How beautiful is wisdom for the aged, and glorious are understanding and counsel!
verses.25:8: The crown of old men is much experience, and their glory is the fear of God.
verses.25:9: I have magnified nine unsuspected things of the heart, and the tenth I will speak to people with my tongue:
verses.25:10: a man who delights in his children, living and seeing the downfall of his enemies.
verses.25:11: Blessed is he who lives with a sensible woman, and who has not slipped with his tongue, and who has not served those unworthy of him.
verses.25:12: Blessed is he who finds a true friend, and who declares righteousness to a listening ear.
verses.25:13: How great is he who finds wisdom and knowledge! Yet he is not above the one who fears the Lord.
verses.25:14: The fear of God has placed itself above all things.
verses.25:15: Blessed is the man to whom it has been granted to have the fear of God; he who holds it, to whom will he be compared?
verses.25:16: The fear of God is the beginning of His love, and the beginning of faith must be joined closely to it.
verses.25:17: Every wound is sorrow of heart, and every malice is the wickedness of a woman.
verses.25:18: And he will see every wound, yet not a wound of the heart:
verses.25:19: and every wickedness, yet not the wickedness of a woman:
verses.25:20: and every affliction, yet not the affliction of those who hate:
verses.25:21: and every vengeance, yet not the vengeance of enemies.
verses.25:22: There is no head more wicked than the head of a serpent,
verses.25:23: and there is no anger above the anger of a woman. It will be more pleasing to stay with a lion and a dragon than to live with a wicked woman.
verses.25:24: The wickedness of a woman changes her face, and darkens her expression like a bear, and displays it like sackcloth. In the midst of her neighbors
verses.25:25: her husband groaned, and hearing, he sighed a little.
verses.25:26: All malice is small compared to the malice of a woman; may the lot of sinners fall upon her.
verses.25:27: Like a sandy ascent for the feet of an aged man, so is a talkative woman to a quiet man.
verses.25:28: Do not gaze upon a woman's beauty, and do not desire a woman for her beauty.
verses.25:29: A woman's anger, and shamelessness, and great disgrace.
verses.25:30: If a woman holds supremacy, she is opposed to her husband.
verses.25:31: A downcast heart, a sad face, and a wound of the heart: a wicked woman.
verses.25:32: Weak hands and slack knees: a woman who does not make her husband happy.
verses.25:33: From a woman the beginning of sin came to be, and through her we all die.
verses.25:34: Do not give your water an outlet, not even a little, nor to a wicked woman permission to go out.
verses.25:35: If she does not walk at your hand, she will put you to shame in the sight of enemies.
verses.25:36: Cut her off from your flesh, so that she may not always abuse you.
verses.26:1: Blessed is the husband of a good woman, for the number of his years is twofold.
verses.26:2: A strong woman gladdens her husband, and she will complete the years of his life in peace.
verses.26:3: A good portion is a good woman; in the portion of those who fear God she will be given to a man for good deeds:
verses.26:4: moreover, the heart of the rich and of the poor is good; at all times their face is cheerful.
verses.26:5: Of three things my heart was afraid, and at the fourth my face feared:
verses.26:6: the slander of a city, and the gathering of a mob,
verses.26:7: and a lying accusation, all things heavier than death;
verses.26:8: grief of heart and mourning: a jealous woman.
verses.26:9: In a jealous woman is the scourge of the tongue, communicating to all.
verses.26:10: Like a yoke of oxen that shifts, so also is a wicked woman: the one who holds her is like one who grasps a scorpion.
verses.26:11: A drunken woman is great anger and reproach, and her shame will not be covered.
verses.26:12: The fornication of a woman will be recognized in the lifting up of the eyes and in her eyelids.
verses.26:13: Over a daughter who does not turn herself away, strengthen the watch, so that when an opportunity is found, she may not indulge herself.
verses.26:14: Guard against all shamelessness of her eyes, and do not be surprised if she disregards you.
verses.26:15: Like a thirsty traveler she will open her mouth at the spring, and she will drink from every nearby water, and before every stake she will sit, and before every arrow she will open her quiver until she fails.
verses.26:16: The grace of a diligent woman will delight her husband, and will fatten his bones.
verses.26:17: Her discipline is a gift of God.
verses.26:18: A sensible and silent woman: there is no exchange for an instructed soul.
verses.26:19: Grace upon grace is a holy and modest woman.
verses.26:20: And no weight is worthy of a self-controlled soul.
verses.26:21: Like the sun rising upon the world in the highest places of God, so is the beauty of a good woman for the adornment of her house.
verses.26:22: A shining lamp upon a holy lampstand; so is the beauty of a face upon a steadfast age.
verses.26:23: Golden pillars upon silver bases; so are firm feet upon the soles of a steadfast woman.
verses.26:24: Like eternal foundations on solid rock, so are the commandments of God in the heart of a holy woman.
verses.26:25: Over two things my heart has been grieved, and at the third, indignation has come upon me:
verses.26:26: a warrior failing through poverty; and a sensible man despised;
verses.26:27: and the one who crosses over from righteousness to sin: God has prepared him for the sword.
verses.26:28: Two kinds have appeared difficult and dangerous to me: with difficulty is a merchant freed from negligence, and a shopkeeper will not be justified from sins of the lips.
verses.27:1: Because of poverty many have transgressed, and the one who seeks to become rich turns his eye away.
verses.27:2: Just as a peg is driven into the middle of a joint of stones, so also right between selling and buying sin will be squeezed in.
verses.27:3: Offense will be crushed together with the offender.
verses.27:4: If you do not hold yourself steadfastly in the fear of the Lord, your house will quickly be overthrown.
verses.27:5: Just as dust will remain in the shaking of a sieve, so will a man's perplexity in his thought.
verses.27:6: The furnace tests the vessels of the potter, and the testing of tribulation tests righteous people.
verses.27:7: Just as the cultivation of a tree shows its fruit, so too a word from the thought of a man's heart.
verses.27:8: Before speech, do not praise a man, for this is the testing of people.
verses.27:9: If you pursue righteousness, you will lay hold of her and put her on like a full-length robe of honor, and you will dwell with her, and she will protect you forever, and on the day of recognition you will find a firm support.
verses.27:10: Birds gather to those like themselves, and truth will return to those who practice it.
verses.27:11: A lion always lies in wait for prey; so do sins for those who practice iniquities.
verses.27:12: A holy man remains in wisdom like the sun, whereas a fool changes like the moon.
verses.27:13: In the midst of the senseless, reserve speech for the right time, but in the midst of the thoughtful, be constantly present.
verses.27:14: The talk of sinners is hateful, and their laughter is in the delights of sin.
verses.27:15: Speech that swears much will make the hair of the head stand on end, and its irreverence is a stopping of the ears.
verses.27:16: The shedding of blood is in the quarreling of the proud, and their cursing is grievous to hear.
verses.27:17: Whoever lays bare a friend's secrets loses trust, and he will not find a friend after his own mind.
verses.27:18: Love your neighbor, and unite yourself with him in trust.
verses.27:19: But if you lay bare his hidden things, you will not pursue after him.
verses.27:20: For just as a man who loses his friend, so also is the one who loses the friendship of his neighbor.
verses.27:21: And just as one who releases a bird from his hand, so you have abandoned your neighbor, and you will not catch him.
verses.27:22: Do not pursue him, because he is far away; for he has escaped like a roe deer from a snare, because his soul has been wounded.
verses.27:23: You will no longer be able to bind him up. And for a curse there is reconciliation.
verses.27:24: But to lay bare the secrets of a friend is the despair of an unhappy soul.
verses.27:25: The one who winks with the eye devises wicked things, and no one will cast him off.
verses.27:26: In the sight of your eyes he will sweeten his mouth, and he will marvel at your speeches; but in the end he will twist his mouth, and in your words he will place a stumbling block.
verses.27:27: I have hated many things, and I have not counted them equal to him; and the Lord will hate him.
verses.27:28: Whoever throws a stone high up, it will fall upon his head; and a treacherous blow of the treacherous man will deal out wounds.
verses.27:29: And whoever digs a pit will fall into it, and whoever places a stone for his neighbor will stumble over it, and whoever sets a snare for another will perish in it.
verses.27:30: As for the one who carries out a most wicked plan, it will roll down upon him, and he will not recognize from where it comes to him.
verses.27:31: Mockery and reproach belong to the proud, and vengeance like a lion will lie in wait for him.
verses.27:32: Those who delight in the fall of the righteous will perish by a snare, and anguish will consume them before they die.
verses.27:33: Anger and fury, both are detestable, and a sinful man will hold fast to them.
verses.28:1: Whoever wants to be avenged will find vengeance from the Lord, and He will strictly keep his sins.
verses.28:2: Forgive your neighbor who wrongs you, and then when you plead, your sins will be loosed.
verses.28:3: A man stores up anger against another man, and from God he seeks healing.
verses.28:4: Toward a man like himself he has no mercy, and for his own sins he pleads.
verses.28:5: He himself, though he is flesh, stores up anger and asks for propitiation from God; who will intercede for his transgressions?
verses.28:6: Remember the last things, and cease being hostile.
verses.28:7: For decay and death are imminent in His commandments.
verses.28:8: Be mindful of the fear of God, and do not be angry with your neighbor.
verses.28:9: Be mindful of the covenant of the Most High, and overlook the ignorance of a neighbor.
verses.28:10: Keep yourself from strife, and you will lessen sins.
verses.28:11: For a hot-tempered man kindles strife, and a sinful man will trouble friends, and in the midst of those who have peace he will cast enmity.
verses.28:12: For according to the wood of the forest, so a fire blazes up; and according to a man's strength, so his wrath will be; and according to his wealth, he will heighten his anger.
verses.28:13: A hurried contention kindles a fire, and hasty strife sheds blood, and a testifying tongue brings death.
verses.28:14: If you blow on a spark, it will blaze up like a fire; and if you spit on it, it will be extinguished: both come out of the mouth.
verses.28:15: Cursed is the whisperer and the double-tongued, for he will trouble many who have peace.
verses.28:16: A third tongue has shaken many and scattered them from nation to nation.
verses.28:17: It has destroyed the walled cities of the rich and undermined the houses of great men.
verses.28:18: It has cut down the forces of peoples and broken up strong nations.
verses.28:19: A third tongue has driven out courageous women and deprived them of their labors.
verses.28:20: Whoever pays attention to it will not have rest, nor will he have a friend in whom he may rest.
verses.28:21: The blow of a whip makes a bruise, but the blow of the tongue will shatter bones.
verses.28:22: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword, yet not as many as those who have perished through their own tongue.
verses.28:23: Blessed is the one who is sheltered from a wicked tongue, who has not passed into its wrath, and who has not dragged its yoke, and has not been bound in its chains.
verses.28:24: For its yoke is an iron yoke, and its chain is a bronze chain.
verses.28:25: Its death is a most wicked death, and the underworld is more advantageous than it.
verses.28:26: Its persistence will not endure, but it will hold the ways of the unrighteous, and in its flame it will not burn the righteous.
verses.28:27: Those who abandon God will fall into it, and it will blaze up in them and will not be extinguished; and it will be sent against them like a lion, and like a leopard it will injure them.
verses.28:28: Hedge your ears with thorns; do not listen to a wicked tongue; and make doors and bars for your mouth.
verses.28:29: Melt down your gold and your silver, and make a balance for your words and proper bridles for your mouth.
verses.28:30: And watch out so that you do not by chance slip with your tongue and fall in the sight of enemies lying in wait for you, and so that your fall does not become incurable to death.
verses.29:1: He who practices mercy lends to his neighbor, and he who prevails with his hand keeps the commandments.
verses.29:2: Lend to your neighbor in the time of his need, and in turn repay your neighbor in his due time.
verses.29:3: Confirm your word and deal faithfully with him, and at every time you will find what is necessary for you.
verses.29:4: Many have regarded a loan as a find, and have brought trouble to those who helped them.
verses.29:5: Until they receive it, they kiss the hands of the giver, and in their promises they humble their voice.
verses.29:6: And at the time of repayment he will ask for time, and will speak words of weariness and grumblings, and will make the time an excuse.
verses.29:7: But if he is able to repay, he will resist; he will scarcely repay half of the full sum, and he will count it as a find.
verses.29:8: But if not, he will defraud him of his money and gain him as an enemy for nothing;
verses.29:9: and he will repay him insults and curses, and in return for honor and kindness he will repay him outrage.
verses.29:10: Many have not lent, not out of wickedness, but they feared being defrauded for nothing.
verses.29:11: Nevertheless, toward the humble man be stronger in spirit, and do not keep him waiting for alms.
verses.29:12: Because of the commandment, receive the poor man, and because of his poverty do not send him away empty.
verses.29:13: Lose money for the sake of your brother and your friend, and do not hide it under a stone to be lost.
verses.29:14: Place your treasure in the precepts of the Most High, and it will profit you more than gold.
verses.29:15: Store up alms in the heart of the poor, and this will intercede for you from all evil.
verses.29:16: More than the shield of a mighty man
verses.29:18: it will fight against your enemy.
verses.29:19: A good man gives a pledge for his neighbor, and he who has lost shame will abandon him to himself.
verses.29:20: Do not forget the kindness of a guarantor, for he has given his life for you.
verses.29:21: The sinner and the unclean man flee from a guarantor.
verses.29:22: A sinner ascribes the goods of a guarantor to himself, and one ungrateful in mind will abandon the one delivering him.
verses.29:23: A man stands as guarantor for his neighbor, and when he has lost reverence, he will be abandoned by him.
verses.29:24: A most wicked guarantee has ruined many who were prospering, and has tossed them about like the waves of the sea.
verses.29:25: Whirling mighty men about, it has caused them to migrate, and they have wandered among foreign nations.
verses.29:26: A sinner transgressing the commandment of the Lord will fall into a wicked pledge, and he who attempts to do many things will fall into judgment.
verses.29:27: Rescue your neighbor according to your strength, and watch out for yourself so that you do not fall.
verses.29:28: The beginning of a man's life is water and bread, and clothing, and a house covering shame.
verses.29:29: Better is the sustenance of a poor man under a shelter of planks than splendid banquets abroad without a home.
verses.29:30: Let the least amount please you in place of much, and you will not hear the reproach of staying abroad.
verses.29:31: It is a wretched life, lodging from house to house; and where he lodges, he will not act confidently, nor will he open his mouth.
verses.29:32: He will lodge as a guest, and will feed and give drink to the ungrateful, and in addition to these things he will hear bitter words:
verses.29:33: "Come over, guest, and set the table, and with what you have in your hand, feed the others."
verses.29:34: "Depart from before the honor of my friends; because of the need of my house, my brother has become my guest."
verses.29:35: These things are burdensome to a man who has understanding: the rebuke of a house and the reproach of a lender.
verses.30:1: He who loves his son continually applies lashes to him, so that he may rejoice at his end and not grope at the doors of his neighbors.
verses.30:2: He who teaches his son will be praised in him, and in the midst of his household he will boast in him.
verses.30:3: He who teaches his son drives his enemy into envy, and in the midst of his friends he will boast in him.
verses.30:4: His father has died, and it is as if he has not died, for he has left behind one like himself after him.
verses.30:5: In his life he saw him and rejoiced in him; at his death he was not grieved, nor was he put to shame before his enemies.
verses.30:6: For he left behind a defender of the house against enemies, and one who repays kindness to friends.
verses.30:7: For the souls of his sons he will bind up his wounds, and at every cry his inward parts will be troubled.
verses.30:8: An untamed horse turns out stubborn, and an unrestrained son will turn out headstrong.
verses.30:9: Pamper a son, and he will make you fearful; play with him, and he will grieve you.
verses.30:10: Do not laugh along with him, so that you do not suffer pain, and in the end your teeth will be set on edge.
verses.30:11: Do not give him authority in his youth, and do not disregard his thoughts.
verses.30:12: Bend his neck in his youth, and strike his sides while he is a young child, so that he may not grow hard and disbelieve you, and it will be a pain of soul to you.
verses.30:13: Teach your son and work on him, so that you do not stumble into his shame.
verses.30:14: Better is a poor man who is healthy and strong in vigor than a rich man who is weak and scourged with evil.
verses.30:15: Health of the soul in the holiness of righteousness is better than all gold and silver, and a strong body than immense wealth.
verses.30:16: There is no wealth above the wealth of the health of the body, and there is no delight above joy of the heart.
verses.30:17: Better is death than a bitter life, and eternal rest than persistent sickness.
verses.30:18: Good things hidden in a closed mouth are like servings of banquets placed around a tomb.
verses.30:19: What will a libation profit an idol? For it will neither eat nor smell.
verses.30:20: So is the one who is driven off by the Lord, bearing the wages of iniquity,
verses.30:21: seeing with his eyes and groaning, like a eunuch embracing a virgin and sighing.
verses.30:22: Do not give sorrow to your soul, and do not afflict yourself in your own counsel.
verses.30:23: Gladness of heart, this is a man's life, and a treasure of holiness without failing, and the exultation of a man is long life.
verses.30:24: Have mercy on your soul, pleasing God, and restrain yourself; gather your heart in His holiness, and drive sorrow far away from you.
verses.30:25: For sorrow has killed many, and there is no usefulness in it.
verses.30:26: Envy and anger shorten days, and anxious thought will bring on old age before its time.
verses.30:27: A bright and good heart is at banquets, for its banquets are carefully prepared.
verses.31:1: Sleeplessness over prosperity will waste away the flesh, and the thought of it will take away sleep.
verses.31:2: The thought of foreknowledge turns away the mind, and a severe illness makes the soul sober.
verses.31:3: The rich man has labored in gathering property, and in his rest he will be filled with his good things.
verses.31:4: The poor man has labored in a shortage of sustenance, and in the end he becomes destitute.
verses.31:5: He who loves gold will not be justified, and he who pursues consumption will be filled from it.
verses.31:6: Many have been given over to the downfalls of gold, and their destruction came about through its appearance.
verses.31:7: Gold is a stumbling block for those who sacrifice; woe to those who follow after it! And every unwise person will perish in it.
verses.31:8: Blessed is the rich man who has been found without blemish, and who has not gone after gold, nor hoped in money and treasures.
verses.31:9: Who is this? And we will praise him, for he has done wonders in his life.
verses.31:10: He who has been tested in it and made perfect will have eternal glory: he who was able to transgress and did not transgress, to do evil and did not do it.
verses.31:11: Therefore his good things have been established in the Lord, and the whole assembly of the holy ones will recount his alms.
verses.31:12: Have you sat down at a great table? Do not open your throat over it first.
verses.31:13: Do not speak like this: "Many are the things that are upon it."
verses.31:14: Remember that a wicked eye is evil.
verses.31:15: What has been created more wicked than the eye? Therefore it will weep from its whole face when it sees.
verses.31:16: Do not stretch out your hand first and, defiled by envy, be put to shame.
verses.31:17: Do not be crowded at a banquet.
verses.31:18: Understand the things of your neighbor from yourself.
verses.31:19: Use the things that are set before you like a frugal person, so that, when you eat much, you may not be hated.
verses.31:20: Stop first for the sake of discipline, and do not be excessive, so that you do not happen to give offense.
verses.31:21: And if you have sat down in the midst of many, do not stretch out your hand before them, nor ask to drink first.
verses.31:22: How sufficient a little wine is for an educated person! And in sleeping you will not suffer from it, and you will not feel pain.
verses.31:23: Sleeplessness, bile, and colic are for a senseless man.
verses.31:24: Healthy sleep is in a sparing person; he will sleep until morning, and his soul will delight with him.
verses.31:25: And if you have been forced into eating much, rise from the midst, vomit, and it will refresh you, and you will not bring illness upon your body.
verses.31:26: Listen to me, son, and do not spurn me, and in the end you will find my words.
verses.31:27: In all your works be swift, and no illness will meet you.
verses.31:28: The lips of many will bless one who is generous with bread, and the testimony of his truth is faithful.
verses.31:29: The city will murmur against one who is most wicked with bread, and the testimony of his wickedness is true.
verses.31:30: Do not provoke those who are diligent in wine, for wine has destroyed many.
verses.31:31: Fire tests hard iron; so wine will convict the hearts of the proud when drunk in drunkenness.
verses.31:32: Wine in sobriety is equal to life for people; if you drink it moderately, you will be sober.
verses.31:33: What life is there for one who is deprived of wine?
verses.31:35: Wine was created for gladness, and not for drunkenness, from the beginning.
verses.31:36: Wine, when drunk moderately, is exultation of soul and heart.
verses.31:37: Drinking soberly is health for soul and body.
verses.31:38: Much wine, when drunk, causes irritation, and anger, and many ruins.
verses.31:39: Much wine, when drunk, is bitterness of soul.
verses.31:40: The fury of drunkenness is the stumbling of an unwise person, diminishing strength and causing wounds.
verses.31:41: At a banquet of wine do not rebuke a neighbor, and do not despise him in his gladness.
verses.31:42: Do not speak words of reproach to him, and do not press him by demanding repayment.
verses.32:1: Have they appointed you leader? Do not exalt yourself; be among them like one of them.
verses.32:2: Take care of them, and then sit down; and when all your care has been completed, recline,
verses.32:3: so that you may rejoice on their account, and receive a crown as an ornament of grace, and obtain the esteem of the gathering.
verses.32:4: Speak, you who are older, for it is fitting for you,
verses.32:5: the first word with careful knowledge, and do not hinder the music.
verses.32:6: Where there is no listening, do not pour out speech, and do not exalt yourself at an unsuitable time in your wisdom.
verses.32:7: A small carbuncle gem in an ornament of gold, so is a concert of musicians at a banquet of wine.
verses.32:8: Just as in gold workmanship there is a seal of emerald, so is the melody of musicians with pleasant and moderate wine.
verses.32:9: Listen in silence, and for reverence good favor will come to you.
verses.32:10: Young man, scarcely speak in your own cause.
verses.32:11: If you have been questioned twice, let your answer have a main point.
verses.32:12: In many things be as though ignorant, and listen while keeping silent and inquiring at the same time.
verses.32:13: In the midst of great men do not presume, and where elders are, do not speak much.
verses.32:14: Before hail, lightning will go ahead; and before modesty, favor will go ahead, and for reverence, good favor will come to you.
verses.32:15: And at the hour of rising do not linger; but run ahead first to your house, and there relax, and there play,
verses.32:16: and act on your thoughts, and not in offenses and a proud word;
verses.32:17: and above all these things bless the Lord, who created, and who fills you to overflowing from all His good things.
verses.32:18: He who fears the Lord will receive His instruction, and those who keep watch for Him will find blessing.
verses.32:19: He who seeks the law will be filled by it, and he who acts deceitfully will stumble in it.
verses.32:20: Those who fear the Lord will find righteous judgment, and they will kindle righteous deeds like a light.
verses.32:21: A sinful person will avoid correction, and according to his will he will find a comparison.
verses.32:22: A man of counsel will not destroy understanding; a stranger and a proud man will not dread fear,
verses.32:23: even after he has acted with him without counsel, and he will be convicted by his own pursuits.
verses.32:24: Son, do nothing without counsel, and after the deed you will not regret it.
verses.32:25: Do not go on the way of ruin, and you will not stumble against stones; nor entrust yourself to a toilsome way, so that you may not set a stumbling block for your soul.
verses.32:26: And beware of your children, and watch out for those of your household.
verses.32:27: In all your work, trust your soul in good faith, for this is the keeping of the commandments.
verses.32:28: He who believes God heeds the commandments, and he who trusts in Him will not be diminished.
verses.33:1: Evils will not come upon the one who fears the Lord, but in testing God will preserve him and deliver him from evils. A wise person does not hate commandments and righteous decrees,
verses.33:2: and he will not be wrecked like a ship in a storm.
verses.33:3: A sensible person trusts the law of God, and the law is faithful to him.
verses.33:4: The one who makes an inquiry clear will prepare a word, and having prayed in this way he will be heard; and he will preserve instruction, and then he will answer.
verses.33:5: The heart of a fool is like the wheel of a cart, and his thought is like a turning axle.
verses.33:6: A stallion—so also is a mocking friend: he neighs under everyone who sits upon him.
verses.33:7: Why does one day surpass another, and again one light another, and one year another, from the sun?
verses.33:8: By the knowledge of the Lord they were separated, when the sun was made and kept the command.
verses.33:9: And He altered the seasons and their festival days, and in them they celebrated festival days at the appointed hour.
verses.33:10: Some of them God exalted and magnified, and some of them He placed in the number of days. And all people are from the soil and from the earth from which Adam was created.
verses.33:11: In the abundance of knowledge the Lord separated them and changed their ways.
verses.33:12: Some of them He blessed and exalted, and some of them He sanctified and drew near to Himself; and some of them He cursed and humbled, and turned them away from their separation.
verses.33:13: Like the clay of a potter in his hand, to mold it and arrange it.
verses.33:14: All its ways are according to his arrangement; so is man in the hand of Him who made him, and He will repay him according to His judgment.
verses.33:15: Opposite evil is good, and opposite death is life; so too opposite a righteous man is a sinner. And thus look upon all the works of the Most High: two and two, and one opposite another.
verses.33:16: And I, last of all, kept watch, and was like one who gathers grapes after the grape-harvesters.
verses.33:17: In the blessing of God I too hoped, and like one who harvests grapes I filled the winepress.
verses.33:18: See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all who seek out instruction.
verses.33:19: Hear me, nobles and all peoples; and rulers of the assembly, listen with your ears.
verses.33:20: To son and wife, to brother and friend, do not give authority over yourself during your life, and do not give your property to another, otherwise you might regret it and plead for them.
verses.33:21: While you still survive and breathe, no flesh will change you.
verses.33:22: For it is better that your children ask you than for you to look to the hands of your children.
verses.33:23: In all your works, be preeminent.
verses.33:24: Do not put a blemish on your glory. On the day of the completion of the days of your life, and at the time of your departure, distribute your inheritance.
verses.33:25: Fodder, and a rod, and a burden for a donkey; bread, and discipline, and work for a slave.
verses.33:26: He works under discipline and seeks to rest; loosen his hands, and he seeks freedom.
verses.33:27: A yoke and a strap bend a stiff neck, and constant labors bow down a slave.
verses.33:28: For a malicious slave, torture and shackles; send him to labor, so that he may not be idle.
verses.33:29: For idleness has taught much malice.
verses.33:30: Set him to tasks, for so it is fitting for him. But if he does not obey, bend him with shackles, and do not go to excess upon any flesh; but without judgment do nothing severe.
verses.33:31: If you have a faithful slave, let him be to you like your own soul; treat him just like a brother, because with the blood of the soul you purchased him.
verses.33:32: If you harm him unjustly, he will turn to flight.
verses.33:33: And if, lifting himself up, he departs, you do not know whom to seek or on what road to seek him.
verses.34:1: Empty hope and falsehood belong to a senseless man, and dreams lift up the imprudent.
verses.34:2: Like one who grasps a shadow and pursues the wind, so too is the one who pays attention to false visions.
verses.34:3: This according to that is the vision of dreams: before the face of a person is the likeness of a person.
verses.34:4: From the unclean, what will be made clean? And from a liar, what truth will be spoken?
verses.34:5: Divination of error, and false omens, and the dreams of evildoers are emptiness.
verses.34:6: And like that of a woman in labor, your heart suffers fantasies. Unless a visitation has been sent out from the Most High, do not give your heart to them.
verses.34:7: For dreams have caused many to go astray, and those who hope in them have fallen.
verses.34:8: Without falsehood the word of the law will be fulfilled, and wisdom in the mouth of a faithful person will be made plain.
verses.34:9: The one who has not been tested—what does he know? A man experienced in many things will ponder many things, and the one who has learned many things will declare understanding.
verses.34:10: The one who is not experienced recognizes few things; but the one who has been in many things multiplies malice.
verses.34:11: The one who has not been tested, what sort of things does he know? He who has wandered will abound in wickedness.
verses.34:12: I have seen many things while wandering, and very many usages of words.
verses.34:13: Several times I was in danger even to death because of these things, and I was delivered by the grace of God.
verses.34:14: The spirit of those who fear God is sought, and in His regard it will be blessed.
verses.34:15: For their hope is in the One who saves them, and the eyes of God are upon those who love Him.
verses.34:16: The one who fears the Lord will tremble at nothing and will not be terrified, because He Himself is his hope.
verses.34:17: Blessed is the soul of the one who fears the Lord.
verses.34:18: To whom does he look, and who is his strength?
verses.34:19: The eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear Him: a mighty protector, a support of strength, a shelter from heat, and a shade at midday,
verses.34:20: a warding off of stumbling and a help against falling, exalting the soul and enlightening the eyes, giving health, and life, and blessing.
verses.34:21: The offering of one who sacrifices from what is unjust is blemished, and the mockeries of the unrighteous are not well-pleasing.
verses.34:22: The Lord is solely for those who wait for Him in the way of truth and righteousness.
verses.34:23: The Most High does not approve the gifts of the unjust, nor does He look upon the offerings of the unjust, nor by the multitude of their sacrifices will He forgive sins.
verses.34:24: The one who offers a sacrifice from the goods of the poor is like one who slaughters a son in the sight of his father.
verses.34:25: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; the one who takes it by fraud is a man of blood.
verses.34:26: The one who takes away bread earned in sweat is like one who kills his neighbor.
verses.34:27: The one who sheds blood and the one who commits fraud against a hired worker are brothers.
verses.34:28: One building, and one tearing down: what does it profit them, except labor?
verses.34:29: One praying, and one cursing: whose voice will God hear?
verses.34:30: The one who is washed from a dead body and touches it again: what does his washing profit?
verses.34:31: So is a person who fasts in his sins and again does the same things: what does he profit by humbling himself? Who will hear his prayer?
verses.35:1: He who keeps the law multiplies the offering.
verses.35:2: It is a saving sacrifice to heed the commandments and to depart from all iniquity.
verses.35:3: And to offer a propitiatory sacrifice over injustices, and a plea for sins, is to withdraw from injustice.
verses.35:4: He who offers fine flour will return thanks, and he who shows mercy offers a sacrifice.
verses.35:5: It is well-pleasing to the Lord to depart from iniquity, and it is a supplication for sins to depart from injustice.
verses.35:6: You shall not appear before the presence of the Lord empty.
verses.35:7: For all these things are done because of the commandment of God.
verses.35:8: The offering of the righteous one fattens the altar and is a fragrance of sweetness in the sight of the Most High.
verses.35:9: The sacrifice of the righteous one is acceptable, and the Lord will not forget its memorial.
verses.35:10: With a good spirit render glory to God, and do not diminish the firstfruits of your hands.
verses.35:11: In every gift make your face cheerful, and with exultation sanctify your tithes.
verses.35:12: Give to the Most High according to His gift, and with a good eye present the gain of your hands,
verses.35:13: for the Lord is one who repays, and He will give back to you seven times as much.
verses.35:14: Do not offer corrupt gifts, for He will not accept them.
verses.35:15: And do not look to an unjust sacrifice, for the Lord is a judge, and there is no glory of person with Him.
verses.35:16: The Lord will not favor a person against a poor man, and He will hear the supplication of the injured one.
verses.35:17: He will not despise the prayers of the orphan, nor the widow, if she pours out an utterance of groaning.
verses.35:18: Do the tears of the widow not descend to the cheek, and is her outcry not against the one who brings them down?
verses.35:19: For from the cheek they ascend even to heaven, and the Lord who hears will not take delight in them.
verses.35:20: He who worships God with delight will be accepted, and his supplication will draw near even to the clouds.
verses.35:21: The prayer of the one who humbles himself will pierce the clouds; and until it draws near, it will not be comforted, and it will not depart until the Most High looks upon it.
verses.35:22: And the Lord will not delay, and He will judge the righteous and execute judgment; and the Most Mighty will not have patience with them, so that He may crush their back;
verses.35:23: and He will render vengeance to the nations, until He takes away the fullness of the proud and crushes the scepters of the wicked;
verses.35:24: until He renders to people according to their deeds, and according to the works of Adam, and according to his presumption;
verses.35:25: until He judges the judgment of His people, and He will delight the righteous with His mercy.
verses.35:26: Beautiful is the mercy of God in a time of tribulation, like clouds of rain in a time of drought.
verses.36:1: Have mercy on us, God of all, and look upon us, and show us the light of Your mercies.
verses.36:2: And send Your fear upon the nations that have not sought You out, so that they may know that there is no god except You, and may recount Your great deeds.
verses.36:3: Lift up Your hand against foreign nations, so that they may see Your power.
verses.36:4: For just as in their sight You were sanctified in us, so in our sight You will be magnified in them,
verses.36:5: so that they may know You, just as we also have known that there is no god besides You, Lord.
verses.36:7: Glorify Your hand and right arm.
verses.36:8: Stir up fury, and pour out wrath.
verses.36:9: Remove the adversary, and afflict the enemy.
verses.36:10: Hasten the time, and remember the end, so that they may recount Your wonders.
verses.36:11: In the wrath of flame let the one who escapes be devoured, and let those who mistreat Your people find destruction.
verses.36:12: Crush the head of the enemy rulers who say, "There is no other besides us."
verses.36:13: Gather all the tribes of Jacob, so that they may know that there is no god except You and recount Your great deeds, and You will inherit them just as from the beginning.
verses.36:14: Have mercy on Your people, upon whom Your name has been called, and on Israel, whom You have made equal to Your firstborn.
verses.36:15: Have mercy on the city of Your sanctification, Jerusalem, the city of Your rest.
verses.36:16: Fill Zion with Your inexpressible words, and Your people with Your glory.
verses.36:17: Give testimony to those who from the beginning are Your creatures, and raise up the proclamations which the former prophets spoke in Your name.
verses.36:18: Give a reward to those who wait for You, so that Your prophets may be found faithful; and hear the prayers of Your servants,
verses.36:19: according to the blessing of Aaron concerning Your people; and direct us into the way of righteousness, and let all who inhabit the earth know that You are God, the watcher of the ages.
verses.36:20: The stomach will eat every food, yet one food is better than another.
verses.36:21: The palate tastes the food of wild game, and a discerning heart tastes lying words.
verses.36:22: A perverse heart will give sorrow, and an experienced man will resist it.
verses.36:23: A woman will receive every male, yet one daughter is better than another.
verses.36:24: The beauty of a woman gladdens the face of her husband, and above every longing of a man it brings on desire.
verses.36:25: If there is a tongue of healing, it is also of soothing and mercy; her husband is not like the sons of men.
verses.36:26: He who possesses a good wife begins a possession; she is a helper like him, and a pillar as a rest.
verses.36:27: Where there is no hedge, the possession will be plundered; and where there is no wife, the needy one groans.
verses.36:28: Who trusts the one who has no nest and turns aside wherever it grows dark, like a girded robber leaping from city to city?
verses.37:1: Every friend will say, "I also have joined in friendship," but there is a friend who is a friend in name alone. Is not sorrow present even to death?
verses.37:2: Yet a companion and a friend will turn to enmity.
verses.37:3: O most wicked presumption, from where were you created to cover the dry land with wickedness and its deceitfulness?
verses.37:4: A companion rejoices together with a friend in pleasures, and in the time of distress he will be an adversary.
verses.37:5: A companion suffers together with a friend for the sake of the belly, and against an enemy he will take up a shield.
verses.37:6: Do not forget your friend in your mind, and do not be unmindful of him in your wealth.
verses.37:7: Do not take counsel with one who lies in wait for you, and hide counsel from those who are jealous of you.
verses.37:8: Every counselor puts forth counsel, but there is a counselor for himself.
verses.37:9: Guard your soul from a counselor; know first what his need is, for he himself will think in his own mind,
verses.37:10: so that he may not thrust a stake into the ground and say to you:
verses.37:11: "Your way is good," and stand on the opposite side to see what happens to you.
verses.37:12: Confer with an irreligious man about holiness, and with an unjust man about justice, and with a woman about her who is a rival, with a timid man about war, with a merchant about transport, with a buyer about a sale, with an envious man about giving thanks,
verses.37:13: with an ungodly man about godliness, with a dishonest man about honesty, with a farm laborer about every work,
verses.37:14: with a yearly laborer about the completion of the year, with a lazy slave about much work. Pay no attention to these in any counsel;
verses.37:15: but be continually with a holy man, whomever you know to be observing the fear of God,
verses.37:16: whose soul is according to your soul, and who, when you stumble in darkness, will grieve with you.
verses.37:17: Establish a heart of good counsel with yourself, for there is nothing else of greater value to you than it.
verses.37:18: The soul of a holy man at times declares the truth more than seven watchmen sitting on high to keep watch.
verses.37:19: And in all these things implore the Most High, that He may direct your way in truth.
verses.37:20: Before all works let a truthful word go before you, and before every action, steady counsel.
verses.37:21: A wicked word will change the heart, from which four parts arise: good and evil, life and death; and their continual ruler is the tongue. There is a shrewd man who is an instructor of many, and he is useless to his own soul.
verses.37:22: A skilled man has instructed many, and to his own soul he is sweet.
verses.37:23: He who speaks with sophistry is hateful; in every matter he will be defrauded.
verses.37:24: Grace has not been given to him by the Lord, for he has been defrauded of all wisdom.
verses.37:25: There is a wise man who is wise for his own soul, and the fruit of his understanding is praiseworthy.
verses.37:26: A wise man instructs his people, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.
verses.37:27: A wise man will be filled with blessings, and those who see him will praise him.
verses.37:28: The life of a man is in a number of days, but the days of Israel are innumerable.
verses.37:29: A wise man among the people will inherit honor, and his name will be living forever.
verses.37:30: Son, in your life test your soul, and if it is wicked, do not give it power.
verses.37:31: For not all things are beneficial for all, and not every kind pleases every soul.
verses.37:32: Do not be greedy at every feast, and do not pour yourself out over every food.
verses.37:33: For in many foods there will be sickness, and greediness will draw near even to biliousness.
verses.37:34: Because of overindulgence many have died, but he who is temperate will add to his life.
verses.38:1: Honor the physician because of necessity, for indeed the Most High created him.
verses.38:2: For all healing is from God, and from the king he will receive a gift.
verses.38:3: The learning of the physician will lift up his head, and in the sight of great men he will be praised.
verses.38:4: The Most High created medicines from the earth, and a prudent man will not abhor them.
verses.38:5: Was not bitter water made sweet by wood?
verses.38:6: The power of these things is for the recognition of men, and the Most High gave knowledge to men, to be honored in His marvelous works.
verses.38:7: By these, in healing, he will soothe pain; and the apothecary will make compounds of sweetness, and will prepare ointments of health, and his works will not come to an end.
verses.38:8: For the peace of God is upon the face of the earth.
verses.38:9: Son, in your sickness do not neglect yourself, but pray to the Lord, and He Himself will heal you.
verses.38:10: Turn away from sin, and direct your hands, and cleanse your heart from every sin.
verses.38:11: Give a sweet fragrance and a memorial of fine flour, and make the offering rich, and give place to the physician.
verses.38:12: For indeed the Lord created him, and let him not depart from you, because his works are necessary.
verses.38:13: For there is a time when you fall into their hands.
verses.38:14: And they themselves will implore the Lord, that He may direct their rest and health, on account of their way of life.
verses.38:15: He who sins in the sight of Him who made him will fall into the hands of the physician.
verses.38:16: Son, bring forth tears over the dead, and as one who has suffered dreadful things, begin to weep; and according to judgment cover his body, and do not neglect his burial.
verses.38:17: And because of slander, bitterly bear mourning for him for one day, and be comforted because of sorrow.
verses.38:18: And make mourning according to his merit for one day or two, because of slander.
verses.38:19: For from sorrow death hastens, and it covers over strength, and sorrow of heart bends the neck.
verses.38:20: In carrying away, sorrow remains, and the substance of a poor man is according to his heart.
verses.38:21: Do not give your heart to sorrow, but drive it away from you, and remember the last things.
verses.38:22: Do not forget, for there is no return; and you will be of no benefit to this one, and you will ruin yourself.
verses.38:23: Be mindful of my judgment, for so will yours also be: for me yesterday, and for you today.
verses.38:24: In the rest of the dead, cause the memory of him to rest, and comfort him at the departure of his spirit.
verses.38:25: The wisdom of a scribe is in a time of leisure, and he who is lessened in activity will acquire wisdom, with which wisdom he will be filled.
verses.38:26: He who holds the plow, and he who boasts in the javelin, drives oxen with a goad and is occupied in their works, and his discourse is about the offspring of bulls.
verses.38:27: He will give his heart to turning the furrows, and his wakefulness is in the fattening of cows.
verses.38:28: So also every craftsman and master builder, who passes the night like the day; who carves engraved seals, and his diligence varies the picture; he will give his heart to the likeness of the picture, and by his wakefulness he will complete the work.
verses.38:29: So also the ironsmith, sitting beside the anvil and considering the work of iron: the vapor of the fire will scorch his flesh, and in the heat of the furnace he struggles.
verses.38:30: The sound of the hammer renews his ear, and his eye is opposite the likeness of the vessel.
verses.38:31: He will give his heart to the completion of his works, and with his watchfulness he will adorn them to perfection.
verses.38:32: So also the potter, sitting at his work, turning the wheel with his feet, who is always placed in anxious care on account of his work, and all his labor is by number.
verses.38:33: With his arm he will shape the clay, and before his feet he will bend his strength.
verses.38:34: He will give his heart to finish the glazing, and with his watchfulness he will clean the furnace.
verses.38:35: All these have put their hope in their hands, and each one is wise in his own craft.
verses.38:36: Without all these a city is not built,
verses.38:37: and they will not dwell, nor will they walk about, and they will not pass over into the assembly.
verses.38:38: Upon the seat of the judge they will not sit, and they will not understand the covenant of judgment, nor will they openly declare instruction and judgment, and in parables they will not be found;
verses.38:39: but they will strengthen the creation of the age, and their prayer is in the labor of their craft, applying their soul and searching in the law of the Most High.
verses.39:1: The wise man will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients, and will devote himself to the prophets.
verses.39:2: He will preserve the narrative of renowned men, and at the same time he will enter into the subtleties of parables.
verses.39:3: He will seek out the hidden things of proverbs, and will dwell in the secrets of parables.
verses.39:4: He will serve in the midst of great men, and will appear in the sight of a ruler.
verses.39:5: He will pass through into the land of foreign nations, for he will test the good and evil things among men.
verses.39:6: He will give his heart to keeping watch at dawn toward the Lord, who made him, and will make supplication in the sight of the Most High.
verses.39:7: He will open his mouth in prayer, and he will plead for his offenses.
verses.39:8: For if the great Lord wills, He will fill him with the spirit of understanding,
verses.39:9: and he himself will send forth like showers the sayings of his wisdom, and in prayer he will give praise to the Lord;
verses.39:10: and he himself will direct his counsel and instruction, and he will reflect on his secrets.
verses.39:11: He himself will openly reveal the instruction of his teaching, and will glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.39:12: Many will praise his wisdom, and to eternity it will not be blotted out.
verses.39:13: His memory will not depart, and his name will be sought out from generation to generation.
verses.39:14: The nations will recount his wisdom, and the assembly will proclaim his praise.
verses.39:15: If he remains, he will leave behind a name greater than a thousand, and if he rests, it will profit him.
verses.39:16: I will reflect further so that I may recount, for I have been filled as with frenzy.
verses.39:17: With a voice he says: "Listen to me, divine fruits, and bear fruit like a rose planted beside streams of waters.
verses.39:18: Like Lebanon, have a fragrance of sweetness.
verses.39:19: Put forth blossoms like a lily, and give fragrance, and sprout leaves into grace, and join in praising a song, and bless the Lord in His works.
verses.39:20: Give magnificence to His name, and give thanks to Him with the voice of your lips, and with songs of the lips and with harps; and thus you will say in thanksgiving:
verses.39:21: 'All the works of the Lord are exceedingly good.'"
verses.39:22: At His word water stood like a heap, and at the utterance of His mouth like reservoirs of waters,
verses.39:23: for at His command good pleasure comes to pass, and there is no diminishing in His salvation.
verses.39:24: The works of all flesh are before Him, and there is nothing hidden from His eyes.
verses.39:25: From eternity to eternity He looks, and nothing is marvelous in His sight.
verses.39:26: One must not say, "What is this, or what is that?" for all things will be sought in their own time.
verses.39:27: His blessing has overflowed like a river.
verses.39:28: Just as a deluge has drenched the dry land, so His wrath will inherit the nations that have not sought Him out.
verses.39:29: Just as He has turned waters into dryness, and the earth has been dried up, and His ways have been made straight for their ways, so for sinners there are stumbling blocks in His wrath.
verses.39:30: Good things were created for the good from the beginning; so for the most wicked, good things and evil things.
verses.39:31: The beginning of what is necessary for the life of men: water, fire, and iron, salt, milk, and bread of fine flour, and honey, and a cluster of grapes, and oil, and clothing.
verses.39:32: All these things will be turned into good for the holy, and so also into evil for the ungodly and sinners.
verses.39:33: There are spirits that were created for vengeance, and in their fury they have strengthened their torments.
verses.39:34: In the time of consummation they will pour out their strength, and they will appease the fury of Him who made them.
verses.39:35: Fire, hail, famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance:
verses.39:36: the teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, and serpents, and the sword taking vengeance on the ungodly to destruction.
verses.39:37: In His commands they will feast, and on the earth they will be prepared for need, and in their own times they will not transgress the word.
verses.39:38: Therefore from the beginning I was made firm, and I reflected, and I thought, and I left writings behind.
verses.39:39: All the works of the Lord are good, and He will supply every work in its own hour.
verses.39:40: One must not say, "This is worse than that," for all things will be approved in their own time.
verses.39:41: And now with whole heart and mouth praise and bless the name of the Lord.
verses.40:1: A great toil was created for all men, and a heavy yoke upon the sons of Adam, from the day of coming forth from the womb of their mother until the day of burial into the mother of all.
verses.40:2: Their thoughts, and fears of heart, the imagining of expectation, and the day of ending,
verses.40:3: from the one sitting upon a glorious throne, down to the one humbled in earth and ashes:
verses.40:4: from him who wears violet and bears a crown, down to him who is covered with raw linen: fury, jealousy, turmoil, wavering, and fear of death, persistent anger, and strife;
verses.40:5: and in the time of refreshment on a bed, the sleep of night alters his knowledge.
verses.40:6: Little, as nothing, in rest, and from then on in dreams, as in a day of watch.
verses.40:7: He was troubled in the vision of his heart, like one who has escaped on the day of battle; at the time of his deliverance he rose up, and marveling at no fear,
verses.40:8: with all flesh, from man to beast, and upon sinners sevenfold.
verses.40:9: In addition to these: death, blood, strife, and sword, oppressions, famine, and ruin, and scourges;
verses.40:10: upon the wicked all these things were created, and because of them the deluge came to be.
verses.40:11: All things that are from the earth will turn back to the earth, and all waters will return to the sea.
verses.40:12: Every bribe and iniquity will be blotted out, and faithfulness will stand forever.
verses.40:13: The possessions of the unjust will be dried up like a river, and like a great thunder in rain they will resound.
verses.40:14: In opening his hands he will rejoice; so transgressors will waste away at the end.
verses.40:15: The descendants of the ungodly will not multiply branches, and unclean roots sound upon the top of a rock.
verses.40:16: Greenery upon every water and at the bank of a river will be plucked up before all grass.
verses.40:17: Grace is like a paradise in blessings, and mercy remains forever.
verses.40:18: The life of a self-sufficient laborer will be made sweet, and in it you will find a treasure.
verses.40:19: Children and the building of a city will establish a name, and above these a spotless wife will be reckoned.
verses.40:20: Wine and music gladden the heart, and above both, the love of wisdom.
verses.40:21: Flutes and psaltery make a sweet melody, and above both, a sweet tongue.
verses.40:22: Your eye will desire grace and beauty, and above these, green sown fields.
verses.40:23: A friend and a companion meeting at the right time, and above both, a wife with a husband.
verses.40:24: Brothers are for help in a time of tribulation, and above them mercy will deliver.
verses.40:25: Gold and silver are the establishing of the feet, and above both, well-pleasing counsel.
verses.40:26: Riches and powers exalt the heart, and above these, the fear of the Lord.
verses.40:27: In the fear of the Lord there is no diminishing, and in it there is no need to seek out help.
verses.40:28: The fear of the Lord is like a paradise of blessing, and above all glory they have covered it.
verses.40:29: Son, in the time of your life do not be in want, for it is better to die than to be in want.
verses.40:30: A man looking at another's table: his life is not in the thought of sustenance, for he nourishes his soul with another's foods.
verses.40:31: But a disciplined and educated man will guard himself.
verses.40:32: In the mouth of an imprudent man want will be made sweet, and in his belly a fire will burn.
verses.41:1: O death, how bitter is the memory of you for a man who has peace in his possessions,
verses.41:2: for a man at rest, whose ways are straight in all things, and who is still strong enough to take food!
verses.41:3: O death, your judgment is good for a man in need and for one who is diminished in strength,
verses.41:4: worn out by age, and who has anxiety about everything, and disbelieving, who loses patience!
verses.41:5: Do not fear the judgment of death. Remember what was before you and what is to come upon you: this is the judgment from the Lord for all flesh.
verses.41:6: And what will come upon you in the good pleasure of the Most High? Whether ten, or a hundred, or a thousand years.
verses.41:7: For in the underworld there is no accusation of life.
verses.41:8: The children of sinners become children of abominations, as do those who live beside the houses of the ungodly.
verses.41:9: The inheritance of the children of sinners will perish, and with their seed will be continual disgrace.
verses.41:10: Children complain about an ungodly father, for on account of him they are in disgrace.
verses.41:11: Woe to you, ungodly men, who have abandoned the law of the Lord Most High!
verses.41:12: And if you are born, you will be born in a curse; and if you die, your portion will be in a curse.
verses.41:13: All things that are from the earth will turn back to the earth; so too the ungodly, from a curse to destruction.
verses.41:14: The mourning of people is over their own body, but the name of the ungodly will be erased.
verses.41:15: Take care for a good name, for this will remain with you longer than a thousand precious and great treasures.
verses.41:16: For a good life there is a number of days, but a good name will remain forever.
verses.41:17: Preserve discipline in peace, children. For hidden wisdom and unseen treasure, what benefit is there in both of them?
verses.41:18: A man who hides his foolishness is better than a man who hides his wisdom.
verses.41:19: Nevertheless, have a sense of shame regarding these things that proceed from my mouth:
verses.41:20: for it is not good to observe every reverence, and not all things are well-pleasing to all in faithfulness.
verses.41:21: Be ashamed before father and mother of sexual immorality, and before a ruler and a powerful man of a lie;
verses.41:22: before a prince and a judge of an offense; before an assembly and the populace of wickedness;
verses.41:23: before a companion and a friend of injustice, and from the place in which you live,
verses.41:24: of theft; of the truth of God and the covenant; of reclining on the loaves, and of obscuring giving and receiving;
verses.41:25: before those who offer greetings, of silence; of gazing at a prostitute, and of turning away the face of a relative.
verses.41:26: Do not turn your face away from your neighbor, and of taking away a portion and not restoring it.
verses.41:27: Do not gaze at another man's wife, and do not scrutinize his female servant, nor stand by her bed.
verses.41:28: Before friends, of words of reproach; and when you have given, do not reproach.
verses.42:1: Do not repeat a word you have heard concerning the revealing of a hidden word, and you will truly be without shame, and you will find favor in the sight of all people. Do not be ashamed of all these things, and do not show partiality so as to sin:
verses.42:2: of the law of the Most High and the covenant, and of judgment to justify the ungodly,
verses.42:3: of the word of companions and travelers, and of the giving of the inheritance of friends,
verses.42:4: of the evenness of a balance and weights, of acquiring many things and few,
verses.42:5: of the corruption of buying and of merchants, and of much discipline of children, and of making the side of a very bad servant bleed.
verses.42:6: Over a wicked wife, a seal is good.
verses.42:7: Where there are many hands, lock up; and whatever you hand over, count and weigh; and write down everything given and received.
verses.42:8: Of the discipline of a senseless person and a fool, and of elderly men who are judged by young men; and you will be instructed in all things, and approved in the sight of all the living.
verses.42:9: A daughter is a father's hidden wakefulness, and anxiety over her takes away sleep: for fear that in her youth she may become full-grown, and when living with a husband she may become hated;
verses.42:10: for fear that at any time she may be defiled in her virginity and be found pregnant in her father's house; for fear that when living with a husband she may transgress, or indeed become barren.
verses.42:11: Over a dissolute daughter strengthen the watch, so that she may never cause you to come into disgrace before enemies, from slander in the city and the censure of the populace, and put you to shame in the multitude of the people.
verses.42:12: Do not look intently at any person for beauty, and do not stay in the midst of women;
verses.42:13: for from garments a moth comes forth, and from a woman, a man's wickedness.
verses.42:14: For better is a man's wickedness than a woman doing good, and a woman bringing shame into disgrace.
verses.42:15: Therefore I will be mindful of the works of the Lord, and what I have seen I will declare. In the words of the Lord are His works.
verses.42:16: The sun, giving light, has looked over all things, and His work is full of the glory of the Lord.
verses.42:17: Has not the Lord caused the holy ones to recount all His wonders, which the Lord Almighty has established to stand firm in His glory?
verses.42:18: He has searched out the abyss and the heart of people, and He has pondered their craftiness.
verses.42:19: For the Lord has known all knowledge, and has looked into the sign of the age, declaring what has passed and what is to come, revealing the traces of secret things.
verses.42:20: No thought passes Him by, and no word hides itself from Him.
verses.42:21: He has adorned the great works of His wisdom, He who is before the age and even forever; nor has anything been added.
verses.42:22: Nor is He diminished, and He does not need anyone's counsel.
verses.42:23: How desirable are all His works! And like a spark is what one can observe!
verses.42:24: All these things live and remain forever, and in every need all things obey Him.
verses.42:25: All things are twofold, one opposite the other, and He has made nothing lacking.
verses.42:26: He has established the good things of each one, and who will be satisfied seeing His glory?
verses.43:1: The expanse of the height is His beauty, the appearance of heaven in a vision of glory.
verses.43:2: The sun, when it appears, proclaiming at its going forth, is a marvelous vessel, the work of the Most High.
verses.43:3: At midday it scorches the earth, and before its burning heat who will be able to endure? Tending a furnace in works of burning heat:
verses.43:4: three times over, the sun, scorching the mountains, blowing out fiery rays, and shining brightly with its rays, blinds the eyes.
verses.43:5: Great is the Lord who made it, and at His words it hastened its course.
verses.43:6: And the moon, in all things in its time, is a showing of time and a sign of the age.
verses.43:7: From the moon is the sign of the feast day, a light that diminishes at completion.
verses.43:8: The month is according to its name, increasing wondrously in completion.
verses.43:9: A vessel of the camps on high, shining forth gloriously in the expanse of heaven.
verses.43:10: The beauty of heaven is the glory of the stars; the Lord illuminates the world in the heights.
verses.43:11: At the words of the Holy One they will stand for judgment, and they will not fail in their watches.
verses.43:12: Look at the rainbow, and bless Him who made it; it is exceedingly beautiful in its splendor.
verses.43:13: It encircled heaven in the circuit of its glory; the hands of the Most High opened it.
verses.43:14: By His command He hastened the snow, and He hastens to send forth the lightning flashes of His judgment.
verses.43:15: Therefore the storehouses were opened, and the mists flew out like birds.
verses.43:16: In His greatness He placed the clouds, and the stones of hail were shattered.
verses.43:17: In His sight the mountains will be shaken, and at His will the south wind will blow.
verses.43:18: The voice of His thunder lashed the earth, the storm of the north wind, and the gathering of the wind:
verses.43:19: and like a bird coming down to settle, He sprinkles snow, and like a locust plunging down is its descent.
verses.43:20: The eye will marvel at the beauty of its whiteness, and the heart will stand in awe at its downpour.
verses.43:21: He will pour out frost like salt upon the earth, and when it has frozen, it will become like the points of a thistle.
verses.43:22: The cold north wind blew, and ice froze from the water; upon every gathering of waters it will rest, and like a breastplate it will clothe itself with the waters:
verses.43:23: and it will devour the mountains, and scorch the desert, and extinguish what is green, as with fire.
verses.43:24: The healing of all things is in the hastening of a mist, and the dew, meeting one coming from the burning heat, will make him humble.
verses.43:25: At His word the wind fell silent, and by His thought He calmed the abyss, and the Lord planted islands in it.
verses.43:26: Let those who sail the sea recount its dangers, and hearing with our ears, we will marvel.
verses.43:27: There are splendid and wondrous works, various kinds of beasts and of all cattle, and the creation of monsters.
verses.43:28: Because of Him the end of the journey has been established, and by His word all things have been ordered.
verses.43:29: We will say many things, and we will fall short in words; yet the conclusion of speech is: He Himself is in all things.
verses.43:30: Glorying, for what will we have strength? For He Himself is almighty above all His works.
verses.43:31: Fearsome is the Lord, and exceedingly great, and wonderful is His power.
verses.43:32: Glorify the Lord as much as you are able, for He will still surpass it, and marvelous is His magnificence.
verses.43:33: As you bless the Lord, exalt Him as much as you can, for He is greater than all praise.
verses.43:34: Exalting Him, be filled with strength; do not grow weary, for you will not comprehend Him.
verses.43:35: Who will see Him and tell of Him? And who will magnify Him as He is from the beginning?
verses.43:36: Many hidden things are greater than these, for we have seen few of His works.
verses.43:37: Now the Lord has made all things, and to those who act devoutly He has given wisdom.
verses.44:1: Let us praise glorious men, and our ancestors in their generation.
verses.44:2: The Lord has made great glory; His magnificence is from eternity.
verses.44:3: Ruling in their dominions, men great in strength and endowed with their prudence, proclaiming among the prophets the dignity of the prophets,
verses.44:4: and governing over the present people, and by the strength of prudence speaking most holy words to the peoples,
verses.44:5: in their skill seeking out musical melodies, and recounting the songs of the Scriptures,
verses.44:6: men rich in strength, having a zeal for beauty, keeping peace in their houses.
verses.44:7: All these obtained glory in the generations of their nation, and in their days they are held in praise.
verses.44:8: Those who were born of them left a name for recounting their praises.
verses.44:9: And there are some of whom there is no remembrance; they perished like those who had never been, and they were born as though not born, and their children with them.
verses.44:10: But those are men of mercy, whose acts of devotion have not failed.
verses.44:11: With their seed good things endure;
verses.44:12: their descendants are a holy inheritance, and in the covenants their seed stood;
verses.44:13: and for their sake their children remain forever; their seed and their glory will not be abandoned.
verses.44:14: Their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives from generation to generation.
verses.44:15: Let the peoples recount their wisdom, and let the assembly proclaim their praise.
verses.44:16: Enoch pleased God, and was carried into paradise, so that he may give repentance to the nations.
verses.44:17: Noah was found perfect, righteous, and in the time of wrath he became a reconciliation.
verses.44:18: Therefore a remnant was left to the earth when the flood occurred.
verses.44:19: Covenants of eternity were placed with him, so that all flesh could not be destroyed by a flood.
verses.44:20: Abraham was a great father of a multitude of nations, and no one was found like him in glory; he kept the law of the Most High and was in covenant with Him.
verses.44:21: In his flesh he made the covenant stand, and in testing he was found faithful.
verses.44:22: Therefore with an oath He gave him glory in his nation, that he would increase like a heap of earth,
